correctness.rationale: For arbitrary factor count and orders, vertex transitivity reduces the full three-round game to edge status and four third-point extension-cell possibilities for each ordered distinct pair. All cells are characterized constructively via coordinate equalities. Their realized signatures give seven disjoint classes, each with an explicit representative, and establish the sharp bound 12. A directly implemented recursive three-round EF game (28 representative-pair comparisons and eight cross-size cases), literal adjacency enumeration (54 parameter vectors), and an independent symbolic procedure (494 vectors) all passed. Finite checks corroborate rather than replace the infinite proof.
